description: This file contains compatibility utilities and internal schema handling functions for FastAPI and Pydantic, including model field processing, schema generation, and reference remapping.

classes.name: ModelField
classes.description: Represents a model field with associated metadata, validation, and serialization logic.

methods.name: asdict
methods.description: Converts a FieldInfo object into a dictionary of its attributes.

methods.name: get_schema_from_model_field
methods.description: Generates JSON schema for a given model field, considering overrides and references.

methods.name: get_definitions
methods.description: Generates JSON schema definitions for a set of model fields, including handling of nested models.

methods.name: is_scalar_field
methods.description: Checks if a model field is scalar based on its annotation.

methods.name: is_sequence_field
methods.description: Checks if a model field is a sequence type.

methods.name: is_scalar_sequence_field
methods.description: Checks if a model field is a scalar sequence.

methods.name: is_bytes_field
methods.description: Checks if a model field is a bytes type.

methods.name: is_bytes_sequence_field
methods.description: Checks if a model field is a bytes sequence.

methods.name: copy_field_info
methods.description: Creates a copy of FieldInfo with a new annotation.

methods.name: serialize_sequence_value
methods.description: Serializes a sequence value based on the field's annotation type.

methods.name: get_missing_field_error
methods.description: Returns a validation error dict for a missing required field.

methods.name: create_body_model
methods.description: Creates a Pydantic model class for request or response bodies from fields.

methods.name: get_model_fields
methods.description: Retrieves ModelField instances from a Pydantic model.

methods.name: get_cached_model_fields
methods.description: Returns cached ModelField list for a model.

methods.name: get_model_name_map
methods.description: Creates a mapping from model names to model classes, normalizing names.

methods.name: get_compat_model_name_map
methods.description: Generates a model name map for compatibility with different schema versions.

methods.name: get_flat_models_from_model
methods.description: Extracts all nested models from a given model.

methods.name: get_flat_models_from_annotation
methods.description: Recursively extracts models from type annotations.

methods.name: get_flat_models_from_field
methods.description: Extracts models from a ModelField.

methods.name: get_flat_models_from_fields
methods.description: Extracts models from a sequence of ModelFields.

methods.name: _regenerate_error_with_loc
methods.description: Adjusts error locations by prefixing with a given path.
